body.name: \mathsf{Cert}
body.construction: Enumerate every \(G\in\mathfrak G_{H,L}(\mathcal S)\) and every raw branch \(r\in\mathcal R_G\), and apply block-structured quantifier elimination over the real closed field to its simplex constraints and equations \(P_G(\lambda)=p\). If every branch is infeasible, return the refinement enumeration ledger and, for every \(G\) and \(r\), either a replayable sign-invariant real-algebraic elimination trace or a rational Positivstellensatz identity certifying infeasibility. Otherwise isolate each global extreme by a square-free integer polynomial and rational interval, extract an algebraic sample point \(\lambda^*\), and decode \(\lambda^*\) through the raw canonical response catalogue into independent finite latent weights and deterministic structural tables.
